detaileddescription.para: Engine is a pure parser: it owns the persistent Lua state so that custom action execute functions remain callable at keypress time, and it maintains internal vectors for key bindings, popup entries, and custom actions. All config scalars (display, nexus, whelmed, keys prefix/timeout, popup defaults) are written into the CONFIG ValueTree received via load().
